title: Love & Lies
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a near-future Japan, the government assigns every 16-year-old a marriage partner by compatibility to raise the birth rate, and refusing carries heavy penalties. Just before his notice arrives, Yukari confesses to his crush Misaki and learns she loves him too, but he is assigned Ririna, who agrees to let him date Misaki so she can learn what love is. Ministry officials watch the case, and the final volume was published in two versions, one ending with each girl.
life_message: Real love is chosen freely and honestly, even when the state or society would choose for you.

content.note: Government monitoring and penalties create mild dystopian tension (AniList Dystopian 74).
